verdict.rationale: YYLO surfaces completion via a 'watch receipt' with state COMPLETED (yylo-gh-2) and can return completed responses to their originating Slack/GitHub thread (yylo-docs-10), which functions as a notification-on-completion mechanism. However, there is no documented alerting when an agent is blocked or needs input—only ledger status fields like 'blockers' (yylo-docs-19) that a developer would have to poll rather than receive a push notification for. Missing for 10: explicit 'needs input' notification/alerting, push notification channels beyond thread replies, and independent/hands-on confirmation that notifications actually fire in practice.
